topic: Tool control system – introduction and need of tool control set up, Tool control procedures, duties and responsibilities of tool controller
syllabus_extract: Tool control system – introduction and need of tool control set up, Tool control procedures, duties and responsibilities of tool controller, maintenance of tool out fits and procedure for use of forms TC-14, TC-15, LP tool procurement and survey/ demand of tool.
specific_objectives: 1.1.3.2 Trainee will be able to describe tool control, checks on ground support equipment for various operations.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Demonstration of Tool Control Box (TCB) assembly, verification of tool count against TC-14, and simulation of tool loss reporting procedure.
intro_questions: What is the primary purpose of a tool control system?
Why is tool control critical during aircraft maintenance operations?
What are the potential consequences of a missing tool in an aircraft?

summary_questions: Explain the specific duties of a tool controller during a maintenance shift.
Describe the correct procedure for completing form TC-14 and TC-15.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief report outlining the steps required for LP tool procurement and survey demand, referencing the procedures covered in this lesson.
